learning_outcomes.text: Students know the fundamentals of statics and can apply static methods to technical problems.
They can determine support reactions, joint forces, and internal forces of statically determinate and indeterminate planar or spatial components.
Students can apply the fundamentals of friction to real structures.

syllabus_topics: Planar statics of rigid bodies: force systems, equilibrium; internal forces; multi-part planar structures
Spatial statics of rigid bodies: forces and moments in space
Friction: static friction, kinetic friction; rope friction
assessment_rules: The module completion examination consists of a 120-minute written exam. The exam assesses the students' ability to apply basic static methods to technical problems. Credit points are awarded upon passing the module completion examination.
